boundaries: Unknown, additional or modified input identities cannot use the reviewed notice file.

Original notebook provenance, notebook SHA256 and full license-text hash must match; source paths remain canonical and cannot escape through symlinks.
The real Git archive test selects the explicit pinned notice file with literal pathspecs and excludes unselected notices and old experiment artifacts.
Existing exact bundled-notice equality, scientific controls, native trials and final release checks remain required.
limitations: Pre-reviewed copied-input identities only; changed/derived inputs require an explicit new review.
The live manifest component check does not independently rehash raw data or establish terminal archive durability.
